title: OverturoBlockInvocation
description: One Conductor cascade block invocation. Surfaced in the OverturoDecision.block_invocations array when the caller opts into decomposition.

position.description: Cascade position (7-15; positions 6 and 12 are reserved per Oap::CascadeStep).

evaluator_class.description: FQDN of the evaluator class that produced this decision (BuiltinEvaluator or customer-extended).

policy_engine.description: Customer-provided free-string label naming the policy engine. 'unknown' for built-in evaluators.

cache_outcome.description: Set to 'hit' when the decision cache served this invocation; null otherwise.

reason_code.description: Set ONLY on decision=deny. Closed enum from Oap::Errors::REASON_CODES.

failed_bound.description: Set ONLY on decision=deny. Which bound triggered the deny (scope_bounds, action_bounds, etc.).
